parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: **1** to **100**. Default value: **20**.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The token used for the next query.

- If this is your first query or no next query is to be sent, you can leave this parameter empty.

- If a subsequent query is to be sent, set this parameter to the value of **NextToken** from the previous API response.

parameters.name: ServerGroupIds
parameters.description: The server group IDs. You can specify up to 20 IDs in a single request.

parameters.name: ServerGroupNames
parameters.description: The server group names. You can specify up to 10 names in a single request.

parameters.name: ServerGroupType
parameters.description:
The type of the server group. Valid values:

- **Instance**: allows you to add servers of the ECS, ENI, and ECI types.

- **Ip**: allows you to add servers with specified IP addresses.

- **Fc**: allows you to add Function Compute functions as backend servers.

- If you do not specify this parameter, the system queries server groups of all types.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags. You can specify up to 10 tags in a single request.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC).
